name: SearchUnify Drupal Connector
description: Connects Drupal to the SearchUnify hosted search platform: a search-results page, proxy REST endpoints, and a JWT auth endpoint.
project_description:
SearchUnify is a unified cognitive platform built on a core of cognitive technology, generative AI, machine learning & an insights engine. It powers intelligent enterprise search & multiple AI-based support applications.

 SearchUnify’s enterprise search enables admins to manage and deliver personalized, contextual and intuitive digital experiences with your Drupal-powered site. SearchUnify’s search client for Drupal unifies all your disparate content silos, fetches content from them, and displays search results on your Drupal-powered website ranked according to their relevance for the user - making it their go-to place for everything. It gives you insights into what your site visitors are looking for, what they do and what they don’t find useful, so you can further control and manage their experience. SearchUnify’s algorithms leverage NLP to identify the context of user queries instead of just the keywords and powers an intelligent autocomplete that understands what your user is searching for.

 Features 
 Intelligent Enterprise Search

AI-powered Relevance & Manual Tuning

ML-Powered Personalization

NLP-fueled Contextual Results

Rich Search Analytics & Reporting

AI-powered Support Applications

Rich Snippets & Knowledge Graphs

Intelligent Spell Check, synonym & acronym recognition

NLG-fueled reports for Next Best Action

Intent Detection & Entity Extraction

Content Gap Analysis

An analyst & award winning cognitive platform, with recognitions from Forrester, IDC, SoftwareReviews, Stevies, G2 and ICMI, SearchUnify powers improved outcomes for customers across verticals. Leading global enterprises including Automation Anywhere, Rubrik, Databricks, Broadcom, and more trust SearchUnify for achieving revolutionized information discovery.
